name: ROCKWOOL A/S
via: largest single shareholder is the non-commercial ROCKWOOL Foundation, with 23% of the share capital and 28% of the votes (rockwool.com governance page, 2026-10-03)
note: Danish stone-wool maker (ROCKWOOL Group), headquartered in Hedehusene and listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen with A shares (51.1% of capital, ten votes each) and B shares (48.9%, one vote each). ROCKWOOL A/S is the ultimate parent in this chain: no majority shareholder, no state or state fund.
